atomicity: The two AARs are an INDIVISIBLE pair. Never replace or swap only one AAR. On ANY AT update, regenerate the ENTIRE bundle from a clean build so the pair, hashes, and metadata stay in lockstep.

engine.logicalComposition: AT Engine = AT Runtime + AT Core

coreModule.role: Frozen implementation + JNI + native libs (reached ONLY via AT Runtime)

publicContract.rule: External consumer production source MUST import ONLY com.androidterminal.runtime.* stable contract. Zero imports of TerminalRuntime, AdbManager, AtWirelessConnector, RecoveryCoordinator, EndpointStore, DiscoveryBackend, NsdManager, _adb-tls-connect, hardcoded ports, or recovery internals.
